target: WIN-038 + WIN-029 citation audit: verify Sentman year and DOI mismatch, verify Collin Ch. 5 for cylindrical waveguide Bessel modes
kernel_of_truth: The dome-review's Schumann-cluster citations are of the right shape — real Sentman papers, real Collin textbook, real Nickolaenko & Hayakawa textbook. The c10 review's Sentman-year concern was that WIN-038 cites 1987 while WIN-029 cites 1990 uncited — legitimate cause for audit. On investigation, both citations are correct and the papers are distinct.

sentman_1987_win038.resolved_to: D.D. Sentman (1987). Magnetic elliptical polarization of Schumann resonances. Radio Science 22(4):595-606.
sentman_1987_win038.contextual_fit: WIN-038 detail_evidence + detail_verdict_text uses Sentman 1987 to support the ~0.5 Hz diurnal-variation claim. The paper reports "differences of as much as 0.5 Hz" between orthogonal magnetic components based on September 1985 measurements — direct empirical support for the ~0.5 Hz variation figure. Correct paper for the claim.
sentman_1987_win038.source_verification: WebSearch resolved DOI to Wiley/AGU record; title, journal, volume, issue, page all confirmed by multiple independent references.

sentman_1990_win029.resolved_to: D.D. Sentman (1990). Approximate Schumann resonance parameters for a two scale-height ionosphere. J. Atmos. Terr. Phys. 52(1):35-46.
sentman_1990_win029.journal_verified: Journal of Atmospheric and Terrestrial Physics, vol 52, issue 1, pages 35-46 (also indexed as JATP...52...35S at NASA ADS)

Correct paper for the claim; separate work from Sentman 1987.

sentman_1990_win029.action_needed: MINOR — enhance the bare "Sentman 1990" citation to a DOI-linked anchor for parity with WIN-038 citation style. Not a factual error; a citation-hygiene improvement.

collin_field_theory_ch5.cited_as: Collin, Field Theory of Guided Waves, 2nd ed., Ch. 5
collin_field_theory_ch5.resolved_to: Robert E. Collin (1990/1991). Field Theory of Guided Waves. 2nd ed. IEEE Press. ISBN 0-87942-237-8. LCCN 90042254. OCLC 22118696.
collin_field_theory_ch5.chapter_verified: Chapter 5, "Waveguides and Cavities." Multiple independent references confirm the 2nd-edition TOC places "Waveguides and Cavities" as Chapter 5 (following Ch 1 Basic Electromagnetic Theory, Ch 2 Green's Functions, Ch 3 Transverse Electromagnetic Waves, Ch 4 Transmission Lines). Semantic Scholar description states "The theory of uniform metallic waveguides is developed in the fifth chapter," corroborating the placement.
collin_field_theory_ch5.contextual_fit: WIN-038 uses Collin Ch. 5 as the source for the cylindrical-waveguide Bessel-mode formulas f = j_{n,m} · c / (2πa) with Bessel-zero eigenvalues j_{0,1}=2.4048 (TM_{01}), j_{1,1}=3.8317 (TM_{11}), j'_{1,1}=1.8412 (TE_{11}). Chapter 5 ("Waveguides and Cavities") in the 2nd edition is the correct location for uniform metallic-waveguide mode theory including circular cross-section (cylindrical) TE and TM modes with Bessel-zero eigenvalues.
collin_field_theory_ch5.source_verification: Book identifiers verified via Open Library (edition OL1881593M, 1990 IEEE Press, 851 pages). Chapter placement corroborated by TOC listing and description text from multiple independent search-result sources.

sentman_1995_scope_note.resolved_to: D.D. Sentman (1995). Schumann Resonances. In H. Volland (Ed.), Handbook of Atmospheric Electrodynamics, Vol. 1, pp. 267-298. CRC Press, Boca Raton, FL.
sentman_1995_scope_note.verification_note: Sentman 1995 (Volland handbook chapter) is a third distinct Sentman reference used elsewhere in the review (WIN-002 + Part 10). Verified as real and correctly attributed. The DOI cited in WIN-002 (10.1007/978-3-662-03137-4_11) resolves to a Springer identifier — the Volland handbook was published by CRC Press in 1995, and reprints/electronic reissues via Springer and Taylor & Francis use different DOIs. Not this EXP's scope to reconcile; flagged for optional future audit if the decider wants to normalize the WIN-002 DOI. Recommend leaving as-is unless a separate citation-hygiene EXP is opened.

anticipated_objections.objection: Why not also patch WIN-002's Sentman 1995 citation (currently uses a Springer DOI 10.1007/978-3-662-03137-4_11 for a CRC Press book — potentially non-canonical)?
anticipated_objections.response: Out of scope for EXP-647 as authored by the c10 curmudgeon review, which explicitly bundled only (a) Sentman 1987 verification and (b) Collin Ch. 5 verification. WIN-002's Sentman 1995 was flagged internally during this audit and noted in the audit_findings block for the decider's future review; a separate citation-hygiene EXP can address it if the operator wants to normalize the DOI. Recommending against expanding scope here — the c10 curmudgeon reviewer's scope call should be respected unless the operator overrides.

anticipated_objections.objection: Sentman 1987 is about magnetic ellipticity of Schumann resonances, not long-term stability. Isn't Sentman 1995 (the Volland handbook review chapter) a more topical citation for WIN-038's long-term-stability claim?
anticipated_objections.response: Partially valid but not a defect requiring change. WIN-038's citation of Sentman 1987 is paired with Nickolaenko & Hayakawa 2002 — the Sentman 1987 paper supplies the ~0.5 Hz diurnal-variation empirical figure, while Nickolaenko & Hayakawa 2002 is the review-textbook covering the decadal-mean and geomagnetic-storm behavior. The pairing is empirically apt: Sentman 1987 (~0.5 Hz split) + Nickolaenko & Hayakawa 2002 (decadal ±0.1 Hz) covers the two claim components. Using Sentman 1995 would be equally valid but not an improvement; the current pairing is defensible and non-substitution is the low-risk call.

anticipated_objections.objection: The Collin Chapter 5 verification relies on second-hand TOC extraction rather than direct book inspection. Doesn't this leave residual uncertainty?
anticipated_objections.response: Three independent lines of evidence converge on the placement: (1) Open Library's TOC listing places Waveguides and Cavities as the fifth chapter after the front matter and four chapters of increasingly specific material; (2) an independent search-result quote explicitly states "The theory of uniform metallic waveguides is developed in the fifth chapter"; (3) the topical progression Basic EM → Green's Functions → TEM Waves → Transmission Lines → Waveguides & Cavities is the standard pedagogical sequence for a graduate EM textbook, matching Collin's known emphasis. Zero independent sources place cylindrical waveguide Bessel modes in a different chapter of this 2nd-edition text. Residual uncertainty is bounded (< a few percent probability of chapter-number typo) and would not affect the substantive physics claim in WIN-038 either way — the formulas are correct regardless of chapter number.

summary_for_decider: EXP-647 audits three citations flagged by curmudgeon-WIN-038.c10 (bundled hole 4 Sentman year + hole 6 / c9 hole 4 Collin chapter). All three verify as correctly attributed: Sentman 1987 (WIN-038, doi:10.1029/RS022i004p00595, Radio Science 22(4):595-606, magnetic ellipticity) and Sentman 1990 (WIN-029, doi:10.1016/0021-9169(90)90113-2, J. Atmos. Terr. Phys. 52(1):35-46, two-scale-height cavity mode approximation) are two distinct real papers — not a year-mismatch error. Collin, Field Theory of Guided Waves 2nd ed. (1990 IEEE Press, ISBN 0-87942-237-8), Chapter 5 ("Waveguides and Cavities") is confirmed as the correct chapter for uniform-metallic cylindrical-waveguide Bessel-mode formulas. One narrow prose patch on WIN-029: enhance the bare "Sentman 1990" citation to a DOI-linked anchor for parity with WIN-038's citation style; no other text changes needed. Sentman 1995 (Volland handbook) noted as OUT OF SCOPE — used in WIN-002 with a Springer DOI (possibly non-canonical for a CRC Press book) but c10 curmudgeon did not include it in the audit bundle; flagged for decider awareness only. review_class: verification (batchable; the deep work is already done in this file — decider should self-apply the WIN-029 anchor patch, then curmudgeon re-verify in a verification-class batch).
